title: FreshRoute — Dairy Distribution
subtitle: The morning inventory board this site started as

source.publisher: Kaggle (Dairy Goods Sales Dataset), a static export
source.note: STATIC, not live. This is a real export, downloaded once. It drifts further from reality every day, and nothing in the file says so. The live board is linked above.

grain.note: This file is a transaction log, not a stock snapshot. We take the latest row per product × location × brand — that gives 600 real current items. Don't sum across locations: surplus in one place would hide a stockout in another.

charts.title: Shortages by location
charts.insight: 19% of tracked positions sit below their minimum stock, bunched unevenly across 15 locations.
charts.form_why: Horizontal bars because the labels are long. One measure, named categories — you read them without tilting your head. We skipped a map: these locations are admin regions, not a spatial pattern.
charts.method: When 13 same-day stock readings disagreed, we kept the lower one. The chart uses that cleaned copy. Why lower: an under-read costs some extra inventory; an over-read costs a stockout.
charts.caution: Raw counts per location — not per-capita, not per-SKU. The chart says so on the label. The biggest bar is not proof of the worst-run site.

cannot_answer: Anything current. The export stopped in 2022. Every expiry-window feature checks dates against a file whose last recorded day is long gone.
Why anything is unprofitable. There is no cost column. The data can spot what needs attention, but never explain the economics.
